newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.478 billion yuan from 954 million with the seven-day contract the most active.
Traders said the news that the central bank's head office had started to do re-discount business with headquarters of major commercial banks since March 1 dampened market sentiment.
"The move will sharply increase money supply on the interbank market and is likely to depress the chibor rates in the short term," said one trader.

But increased trading by short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, will partly offset the impact, traders said. The centres are doning more business due to increased demand from securities houses with stock markets having been in a strong uptrend in the recent weeks, they said.
